data.body:
CLOSE SEQUENCE STARTED — the close gate is stricter than I had planned for, and correctly so.

1. ALL FOUR first close attempts REFUSED because the acceptance-criteria CHECKBOXES were unticked.
   I wrote ACs as '- [ ]' checklists and never resolved them. The gate requires each box ticked, and
   it is right to: an unticked box is an unfinished claim.

2. VERIFYING BEFORE TICKING FOUND TWO GENUINELY UNDONE ACs — this is the part worth recording,
   because ticking blind would have shipped a false claim:
     15f2 AC7 'the check and the marker are documented alongside the existing isolation helpers' —
       NOT met. The guard was documented only in its own module docstring; nothing in docs/.
     b0ac AC6 'atomic_write's role as the single house helper for this class is documented where the
       isolation helpers are documented' — NOT met. docs/concurrency.md mentions atomic_write only in
       the tickets-branch write-lock context, and the implementer had explicitly left placement to me.
   Wrote both sections into docs/concurrency.md (a natural home: it already carries the
   '.tmp-newticket-*' atomic-create convention), amended them into 2505 and 2506 respectively,
   re-verified every patchset still collects clean, and pushed. 2503/2504 were unchanged and kept
   their green votes.

3. f9b9 close then refused a SECOND time, on the completion verifier: AC3's stated verification
   command was WRONG. 'rebar deps f9b9' cannot show the discovered_from links because they are
   recorded as OUTBOUND edges on each CHILD — the same inbound/outbound asymmetry that made my own
   earlier AC3 check read as a false negative. Tagged AC3 [non-codebase] per the verifier's own
   guidance, verified child-side that 14/14 children carry the edge, and recorded the full list with
   the working command as a ticket comment.

4. That AC3 REWORDING then invalidated the plan-review attestation (stale-material). The gate's
   message is precise and worth keeping: ticking an AC checkbox is attestation-SAFE — box state is
   normalized out of the fingerprint — but editing AC TEXT is not. Re-review running for f9b9 only.
   Confirmed empirically: after ticking 36 boxes across b0ac/15f2/0880/9ca8 with NO text edits, all
   four remain certified.

CLOSED SO FAR: 8ce5 cream-capitate-snake (verifier PASSED).
BLOCKED ON: f9b9 re-review; CI on 2505/2506 (ps4, docs) and 2507/2510.
